reviews.title: pretty good!
reviews.comment: it's a really nice case, very roomy, but the panel screws are a little weird. they can strip a little. i think it isn't entirely worth 100 bucks, (unless the fan in there is really good) but it's definitely the nicest looking case i've seen. I'll write an update for once i assemble all the parts. update: perfectly fits all of my parts, looks really great, assembling things is easy, although after an air cooler is installed it is a little hard to work in (depends on the air cooler tho) and i guess that's just because it's matx.
reviews.author: A C

reviews.title: Looks Great! good Case
reviews.comment: Beautiful case! I was surprised by the quality of this case since it was sub $100. I was impressed by how quiet the included fan is. The case material is thicker than most budget cases I've used. No sharp edges. Space is limited so you have to think ahead. Motherboard, CPU, ram first Front panel connectors second. AIO next Power supply Back fan Bottom fans If using bottom fans don't expect to use card slots in that area. It could probably have better airflow, but it's adequate.
reviews.author: RKKing

reviews.title: Good, solid case with above average looks
reviews.comment: It's a nice case. The ease of building the system was about average. I've had better and I've had worse. The looks bump it above average. The front is solid wood, finished well, and gives the whole thing the look of a nice vintage radio. The curves of the sides and the design of the front vents echoes art deco designs of the 1940s, and should fit easily into any room's design just like those art deco pieces did back then. On a practical level, the footprint of the case is just right for its configuration. The handle feels bulletproof. And with holes all over the place, ventilation will be no problem. I'd buy this case again.
reviews.author: Big T

reviews.title: Great find
reviews.comment: Just got the case and I love it! The size, build quality, size, it fits my full sized power supply from an old rig and to top it all off it can be disassembled very easily to put in components into tight spots while also coming back together into a very sturdy feeling build. The only thing I'd say let me down would be it only comes with a single fan in back but honestly that's probably just to keep the price so low. All in all I'll buy more if I decide to put together a PC as a gift in the future. (I'll post pics later after I finish putting it together.)
